name: CombatMeter
description: Real-time party DPS/HPS meter with role colours.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Live party DPS/HPS with role colours.
History — damage timeline with navigator and per-source table.

added: Battles with more than one boss are now tracked per boss: each boss gets its own HP, movement replay, and damage/healing breakdown on the logs website.
Raids are now recognised as clears automatically, even when the bosses are finished off by a scripted event instead of dropping to zero HP.
Elite enemies are now recorded alongside bosses, with their own stats and replay.
changed: Your run is recorded from the moment you enter the dungeon through to the end, more reliably across every boss stage.
fixed: Damage from your summoned companions is now captured more completely (requires framework 2.0.1).
